description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class `BaseViewEmployeeController` within the OrangeHRM project. It extends core framework classes to provide functionalities for viewing employee-related data, including permission checks, menu configuration, and rendering logic. It includes methods for managing services, permissions, and rendering views for employee data.

classes.name: BaseViewEmployeeController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for viewing employee data with permission checks, menu setup, and rendering logic in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getPimLeftMenuService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PIMLeftMenuService instance used for retrieving employee menu items.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Handles rendering of the employee view, including setting up menu tabs, allowed file types, and max file size properties for the view component.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, returning data groups needed for permission capability checks.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the employee data based on the employee number and data group permissions.

methods.name: setPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Sets permission data for a specific employee into the context, based on provided data groups.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the employee is accessible to the current user, either by access rights or if the user is viewing their own data.
